en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a residential street lined with small trees and large villas in front of wooded, terraced hills with vineyards and scattered buildings in the background. The caption at the top reads "Radebeul. Roseggerstraße," indicating a view of Roseggerstraße in the town of Radebeul. The overall style and printing suggest an early‑20th‑century European postcard.
